architecture.finetune: full_ft of sam_mask_decoder + sam_prompt_encoder; image_encoder FROZEN

weights.content: SLIM state_dict: sam_mask_decoder (131 tensors) + sam_prompt_encoder (17 tensors) ONLY
weights.note: encoder weights NOT included; loaded from MedSAM2_latest.pt at build time

train_recipe.reproduce_command: python src/train_f2_sam2.py --mode full_ft --manifest manifests/m2_integral_max_v1c_local.parquet --out outputs/M2_v2_medsam2 --model_id facebook/sam2.1-hiera-tiny --init_ckpt <MedSAM2_latest.pt> --init_ckpt_key model --epochs 30 --batch_size 4 --grad_accum 4 --lr 1e-4 --patience 5 --img_size 1024 --seed 42

evaluation.bucket_A: ISIC2018 test canonical, n=1000, LOCKED (comparable vs production baseline 0.9473)
evaluation.lora_ablation_F7: r=4/8/16/32 not significantly different from full_ft (delta < 0.25pp, within fold noise); full_ft chosen

1_interactive.description: clinician draws the box; box ~= GT
1_interactive.box_jitter_robustness: +/-20px corner jitter -> only -0.86pp (corner precision NOT critical)

2_automatic.DETECTOR_SPEC: box must COVER the whole lesion + ~10% padding; bias LOOSE, NEVER tight

box_scale_robustness_curve.asymmetry: tight (under-cover) much worse than loose (over-cover) at equal box-IoU

robustness_fairness_calibration_F8.fairness_note: equitable across skin tones (0.950-0.961); ITA on peri-lesional dermoscopic skin = proxy
robustness_fairness_calibration_F8.tta_ensemble_note: marginal in box-prompted high-ceiling regime; single model recommended

supra_annotator_IMApp.subset: bucketA images with >=2 human annotators (IMA++), n=312, 2.3 annotators/img
supra_annotator_IMApp.interpretation: model agrees with human consensus (0.915) FAR better than humans agree with each other (0.728); intrinsic label noise ~0.73 is the real task ceiling; model is supra-annotator and inside the human envelope 97.8% of the time
supra_annotator_IMApp.caveat: model is over-confident at ambiguous boundaries (ECE vs soft human label 0.094 > ECE vs hard GT 0.0082)
